subject: chest
text: A treasure chest guarded by a Mummy and a Specter contains Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
They're blocking a treasure chest which contains
Cure Potions.

subject: chest
text: Cutting trees to the left leads to a chest containing 3 Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
From here, head left and cut some trees down, to reach a chest with 3
Heal Potions inside.

subject: chest
text: Stepping on the warp beneath a chopped tree leads to a room with a chest of Refreshers.

evidence.quote:
Defeat him, and chop down the tree to
reach a warp. Step on it, to enter a room with a chest of Refreshers 
(This is actually part of Foresta, though you can't leave the 
building.)

subject: Tristam
text: Talking to the tree with a face prompts Tristam to state that Kaeli should be able to get a response from him.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the
tree with a face, and Tristam will say Kaeli should be able to get a
response from him - She's in Aquaria.

subject: chest
text: Stepping on the warp underneath the lone tree leads to a room with a chest of Ninja Stars.

evidence.quote:
Step on the warp
underneath - you have a stone for this kind - to enter a room with a
chest of Ninja Stars inside.

subject: chest
text: A Specter guards a chest of Refreshers a little north.

evidence.quote:
A little north, there's a Specter guarding
a chest of Refreshers.

subject: chest
text: Defeating the Specter and Mummy near the large dead tree allows access to a chest containing the Giant's Axe.

evidence.quote:
Cut your way around it, and kill
the Specter and the Mummy, to reach a chest with the Giant's Axe in it.

subject: Tristam
text: Talking to Spencer causes Tristam to leave and give Hero his Dragon Claw.

evidence.quote:
Talk to Spencer, and Tristam will leave
you alone - Again. He will lgive you his Dragon Claw though, which is 
a  great deal!

subject: Phoebe
text: Phoebe uses a bomb, causing the tunnel to collapse.

evidence.quote: Next, Phoebe comes, and uses a bomb, causing the tunnell to collapse!

subject: chest
text: Inside Phoebe's house in Aquaria, a chest contains Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Head back up to Aquaria, and go inside Phoebe's house. Grab some Heal
Potions from the chest

subject: Kaeli
text: Talking to Kaeli in Phoebe's house causes her to join you.

evidence.quote: talk to Kaeli, and she'll join you.

subject: Giant Tree
text: Talking to the large tree with a face allows you to enter through his mouth after he tells you to defeat the monsters inside him.

evidence.quote:
Talk to
him, and He'll say you can pass if you defeat the monsters inside of
him. You can enter through his mouth.

subject: chest
text: A Live Oak guards a chest of Refreshers ahead from the entrance.

evidence.quote:
A little farther ahead, is a Live Oak, guarding
a chest of Refreshers.

subject: chest
text: Fighting enemies to the right from the entrance leads to a chest containing Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
If you fight the enemies to the right from where
you enter, you'll reach a chest with Cure Potions inside.

subject: chests
text: A Live Oak and a Specter on the left block two chests containing Heal Potions and Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Farther on the left, a Live Oak and a Specter block
two chests - One with Heal Potions, the other with Cure Potions.

subject: chest
text: Heading right on the second floor leads to a Live Oak blocking a treasure chest containing heal potions.

evidence.quote:
On the next floor, start by heading to the right, and killing the Live
Oak, that's blocking a treasure chest that contains heal potions.

subject: chests
text: Cutting through mushrooms to the left and defeating a Mad Toad leads to a chest with bombs and a chest with Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
cut a path through the mushrooms to the left. Defeat another Mad 
Toad, and you'll reach a chest with bombs, and a chest with Cure 
Potions.

subject: fancy chest
text: Opening the fancy chest through the door yields the Meteor spell.

evidence.quote:
Open the fancy chest to get the Meteor
spell, than backtrack through the mushroom room.

subject: chest
text: Defeating a Mad Toad to the right blocks access to a chest of Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Walk to the right, and defeat the Mad Toad, which is blocking
a chest of Cure Potions, then, climb up the wall.

subject: chest
text: To the right of entering the area is a chest of Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: Right of where you enter, is a chest of Heal Potions.

subject: chests
text: Defeating the Snipion and Mad Toad on the left leads to a chest of Cure Potions and a chest of heal potions.

evidence.quote:
Defeat the snipion and the Mad Toad on your
left, to reach a chest of Cure Potions, and a chest of heal potions.

subject: chests
text: In the room with lots of mushrooms, there are two chests containing Heal Potions and Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
You'll be in another room with
lots of mushrooms. In the room, there are two chests- one with Heal
Potions, one with Cure Potions

subject: chest
text: Climbing down the vine and defeating the Mad Toad leads to a chest of Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Climb down the vine, and defeat the Mad
Toad to reach chest of Heal Potions.

subject: chest
text: Defeating a second Ooze on the left leads to a chest of Heal Potions on the fourth floor.

evidence.quote:
Defeat a second Ooze on the left, to reach a chest 
of Heal Potions, then leave through the door.

subject: chests
text: Walking around the door to the left allows you to reach two more treasure chests.

evidence.quote:
Before you enter 
it though, you can walk around the door to the left, to get two more
treasure chests.

subject: chests
text: In the south end of the fifth floor room, there is a chest of Cure Potions and a chest of Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
In the south end of the room, there is a chest of Cure Potions, and a
chest of Heal Potions.

subject: chests
text: In the northwest corner of the fifth floor, there is a chest of bombs and a chest of Healing Potions.

evidence.quote:
In the north-west corner, there's a chest of
bombs, and a chest of Healing Potions.

subject: Gidrah
text: Gidrah is the boss of the Giant Tree with 13,000 HP, yielding 729 EXP and 18 GP.

evidence.quote:
|          Gidrah - HP 13,000         |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 729     | Battle Strategy: Start by having both Kaeli and Hero |
| GP: 18       |

subject: Gidrah
text: Hero and Kaeli should cast Aero to take out the two Skuldiers with Gidrah and damage Gidrah.

evidence.quote:
Start by having both Kaeli and Hero |
| use Aero, to take out the two Skuldiers that are     |
O--------------O with Gidrah. After they're gone have Hero use Aero

subject: Giant Tree
text: Defeating Gidrah and talking to the face behind him triggers a cutscene where the Tree walks across the world map to a temple, unlocking Kaidge Temple.

evidence.quote:
After you defeat the Gidrah, talk to the face that is behind where he
was. You'll see a cutscene of the Tree actually walking across the world
map, to a temple. Use Exit, or backtrack through the tree, to reach the
world map, where you can now enter Kaidge Temple.

subject: man with the cape
text: Inside Kaidge Temple, talking to the man with the cape mentions Captain Mac before he leaves.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the wall inside the temple, and talk to the man with the cape
again. He'll mention Captain Mac, and leave again.

subject: chest
text: A chest with Cure Potions is reached by walking through the door and navigating left and upward inside Kaidge Temple.

evidence.quote:
You can walk through the door, and navigate left, and upward, to reach a chest with some
Cure Potions, but that's all you can do in here, for now.

subject: Battlefield
text: The Battlefield east of Kaidge Temple contains Ooze, Skuldier, and Water Hag enemies and awards 2808 EXP upon completion.

evidence.quote:
Enemies - Ooze + Skuldier + Water Hag
Reward - 2808 EXP

subject: Ooze
text: Do not cast spells on Oozes because they reflect magic back at you.

evidence.quote:
Remember, do not use spells on Oozes, they reflect
it back at you.

subject: Battlefield
text: The Battlefield east before Windia features Water Hags and Vampires and grants a 2808 EXP reward.

evidence.quote:
Enemies - Water Hag + Vampire
Reward - 2808 EXP

subject: Vampire
text: Aero is effective against Vampires, while Water Hags should be slashed with Giant's Axes.

evidence.quote:
Aero's effective 
against Vampires, but not the Water Hags. Just slash them up with your
Giant's Axes.

subject: Blue Haired girl
text: In the house on the left in Windia, the Blue Haired girl sells a Cupid Locket for 300 GP.

evidence.quote:
The first thing you should do when you enter Windia, is enter the house
on the left. Talk to the Blue Haired girl, and she'll sell you a Cupid
Locket for 300 GP - That's a good deal.

subject: man
text: A man in the house on the left in Windia sells Explosives.

evidence.quote:
If you want, you can also talk
to the man in the house, to buy some Explosives.

subject: Otto
text: Otto in the small house on the right side of Windia explains that his daughter is lost on the mountain.

evidence.quote:
Enter the small house, on the right
side of town, and inside, you can talk to Otto. He'll tell you, that 
his daughter is lost on the mountain - That will be where you head next.

subject: Inn
text: Resting at the Inn in Windia leaves Refreshers and Heal potions in the room upon waking up.

evidence.quote:
Before you go, though, rest up at the Inn. There's even some Refreshers
Refreshers and Heal potions in the room when you wake up - Not bad.

subject: chest
text: Windhole Temple contains one chest of Heal Potions in the center.

evidence.quote:
The place is
empty, except for one chest of Heal Potions in the center, but you may
want them, none-the-less.

subject: chest
text: Defeating the Vampire up from the second set of stairs leads to a chest containing Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Head upward from here, and defeat the 
Vampire to reach a chest that contains Heal Potions.

subject: chest
text: Grappling to another platform and defeating a Vampire reaches a chest of Refreshers.

evidence.quote:
If you head up to the right, you can grapple to another paltform, and
defeat another Vampire to reach a chest of Refreshers.

subject: fancy chest
text: Grappling to the next platform and defeating the Vampire grants access to a fancy chest containing the Apollo Helm.

evidence.quote:
Grapple to the next 
platform, and defeat the Vampire to access a fancy chest with the
Apollo Helm inside.

subject: Dullahan
text: Dullahan is the boss of Mount Gale with 14,000 HP, granting 750 EXP and 21 GP.

evidence.quote:
|         Dullahan - 14,000HP         |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 750     | Battle Strategy: Time for another boss. On the first |
| GP: 21       |

subject: Dullahan
text: Keep both party members alive at all times because Dullahan's Doom Dance is an instant death move.

evidence.quote:
You'll need both      |
| characters at all time, in case he does Doom Dance - |
| an instant death move.

subject: Dullahan
text: On the first round against Dullahan, have both Kaeli and Hero use Aero to kill the Vampires off, then have Hero use Meteor every turn while Kaeli uses Aero.

evidence.quote: Battle Strategy: Time for another boss. On the first...round, have both Kaeli and Hero use Aero, to kill the...Vampires off. Now it's just you and Dullahan...Hero use Meteor ever turn, while Kaeli uses Aero.
